title: (fix) O3-4518: Stock management ESM: Unable to add user role scope on systems with many users
body: ## Requirements - [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui)) - [ ] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests. ## Summary This PR fixes the inability to find and assign user role scopes on systems with many users. ## Screenshots ## Related Issue https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-4518 ### Notes - This follows the exact same pattern already used in the `UsersSelector` component (`src/stock-operations/stock-operations-forms/input-components/users-selector.component.tsx`) - All 112 existing tests pass - Build compiles successfully ## Other
